subject: E1 M-C: shadow-aware decl counting in capture promotion
description: Apply the M3 shadow model to _promote_captured/_count_name_decls: block/sub-nested same-name re-decls are distinct shadows, not blockers; rewrite must skip shadowed scopes. Targets: closure.t, my.t, chdir.t, hashassign.t (also extend multi-decl promotion to all-container lists for hashassign).
